title: RBI Housing Loan LTV Cap - Tier 1 (Up to ₹30 Lakh)
description: Per RBI Master Direction, for individual housing loans up to ₹30 lakh, the maximum LTV ratio is 90%.

title: RBI Housing Loan LTV Cap - Tier 2 (₹30 Lakh to ₹75 Lakh)
description: Per RBI Master Direction, for individual housing loans above ₹30 lakh and up to ₹75 lakh, the maximum LTV ratio is 80%.

title: RBI Housing Loan LTV Cap - Tier 3 (Above ₹75 Lakh)
description: Per RBI Master Direction, for individual housing loans above ₹75 lakh, the maximum LTV ratio is 75%.

title: RBI Gold Loan Regulatory LTV Cap
description: Loans against pledge of gold ornaments and jewellery for non-agricultural purposes cannot exceed 75% of the appraised value of gold.

title: CIBIL Bureau Prime Score Cutoff
description: Applicants with a CIBIL score of 700 and above qualify for standard retail pricing. Scores below 700 require risk escalation.

title: Mandatory PAN Requirement for Large Transactions
description: Income Tax Rule 114B mandates quoting of Permanent Account Number (PAN) or Form 60 for account opening and cash transactions exceeding ₹50,000.

title: IRACP 90-Day Overdue NPA Classification Trigger
description: Per RBI IRACP Master Circular, an advance is classified as Non-Performing Asset (NPA) if interest or principal instalment remains overdue for more than 90 days.

title: Special Mention Account 2 (SMA-2) Incipient Stress Threshold
description: Loans with dues overdue between 61 and 90 days must be tagged as SMA-2 and monitored closely by the Credit Monitoring Committee.

title: Nayak Committee Minimum Borrower Margin for MSME Working Capital
description: Under Nayak Committee Turnover Method, borrower must contribute at least 5% of projected annual turnover from long-term equity/Net Working Capital.

title: Nayak Committee Maximum Permissible Bank Finance (MPBF) Ratio
description: Maximum fund-based working capital finance provided by banks under the turnover method is capped at 20% of projected annual turnover.

title: Minimum Term Loan Debt Service Coverage Ratio (DSCR)
description: Commercial and term loan proposals must maintain a minimum DSCR of 1.20x across the amortization period to ensure debt sustainability.

title: Domestic Bank Priority Sector Lending Overall Target (40% ANBC)
description: Domestic scheduled commercial banks must allocate at least 40% of Adjusted Net Bank Credit (ANBC) or CEOBE to priority sectors.

title: Priority Sector Agriculture Sub-Target (18% ANBC)
description: Commercial banks must direct at least 18% of ANBC to agriculture, with a sub-target of 10% directed towards Small and Marginal Farmers (SMFs).

title: Priority Sector Micro-Enterprises Sub-Target (7.5% ANBC)
description: Commercial banks must direct at least 7.5% of ANBC or CEOBE to Micro Enterprises.

title: Digital Lending Direct Account Disbursal Mandate
description: Per RBI Digital Lending Guidelines, loan disbursal must be executed directly into the borrower's bank account without pass-through via LSP accounts.

title: Mandatory Key Fact Statement (KFS) Provision with APR
description: Regulated Entities must provide a standardized Key Fact Statement (KFS) displaying the all-inclusive Annual Percentage Rate (APR) before executing a digital loan contract.

title: Digital Lending Minimum Cooling-Off / Look-Up Period
description: Digital loans of tenure 7 days or more must provide a minimum 3-day cooling-off period during which borrower can exit without prepayment penalty.

title: DICGC Statutory Deposit Insurance Ceiling
description: Deposits across all branches of a bank are insured by DICGC up to a cumulative maximum of ₹5 Lakhs (principal + interest) per depositor.

title: Scheduled Commercial Banks Minimum Capital Adequacy (CRAR)
description: Per RBI Basel III guidelines, scheduled commercial banks must maintain a minimum CRAR of 9.0% (plus Capital Conservation Buffer where applicable).

title: Housing Finance Companies Minimum Capital Adequacy (CRAR 15%)
description: Per RBI Housing Finance Companies Directions 2025, every HFC must maintain a minimum CRAR of 15% on an ongoing basis (Tier-1 not less than 10%).
